description: Content-addressed object store and CDN layout for immutable benchmark assets. Does not write fold workspaces.

immutability.versioning: asset_id+version+sha256; never mutate an existing object key
immutability.retention: retain forever for published catalog versions; soft-delete forbidden for claim-ready releases

notes: Source publisher URLs (e.g. CELLxGENE) remain authoritative when availability is source_available.
CDN mirrors must byte-match the catalog sha256; mismatches fail closed.
Active fold directories under benchmarks/**/runs are never a storage target.
